description: Enforcement actions from eight regulators: SEC, DOJ, CFTC, OCC, FDIC, FTC, Federal Reserve and FinCEN. Every row is labelled category: "enforcement" (charges, suits, settlements, penalties, orders; every DOJ, Federal Reserve and FinCEN row) or "agency_news" (rules, appointments, speeches, bank-failure notices). By DEFAULT only enforcement is returned; pass category="all" for everything, or category="agency_news" for the news alone. A direct action_id lookup returns the row whatever its category. Rows carry metadata, a teaser and a description capped near 3,000 characters (none for CFTC); the full text is at url. KeyVex adds no severity or outcome signal. SEC, CFTC and FTC are rolling recent windows; Federal Reserve and FinCEN are full history. Sources and ID formats: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_enforcement_actions

agency_component.description: Substring: the DOJ issuing division, or for fed the bank. Empty for most other sources.

text.description: Substring of title, teaser and description, case-insensitive: names of companies or people.

topic.description: Exact topics[] tag: DOJ topic, Fed action type or FinCEN institution category.
